checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan: make VoidFarer Windows-only and replace the neon multi-device cockpit with a readable desktop command console

impact_assessment.why: The user directed Windows-only operation and rejected the previous UI; G-011 still demanded tablet/phone/touch/safe-area behavior, package metadata claimed OS independence, and the cockpit used 8-11px text, mobile breakpoints and a layout that overflowed below 1920x1080
impact_assessment.benefits: One explicit Windows target, no dead mobile/touch code, readable 12px+ labels, a two-column terminal/radar layout with a full-width command dock, and measured zero findings at five Windows viewports
impact_assessment.risks: contract: ui_required evidence is stale until a new reviewed UI task finishes; dependency: only an optional local Edge/Chrome for the audit; concurrency: the dirty tree blocks ui begin until the user commits; state: static UI, tests, docs and pyproject change, while the simulation is untouched
impact_assessment.mitigation: 496-test suite, 4/4 project gates, five-viewport plus menu audit with zero findings, Windows-only tests that forbid touch/mobile markers, ADR-043, and screenshots copied to the ignored ui-review folder for human review

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Verified: Windows-only migration and command-console UI; 496 tests pass, 4/4 gates, cockpit audit zero findings at desktop/laptop/short/ultrawide/4K, menu audit zero findings, vision reviewer gemma-4-31b/evren2 APPROVED, G-015 recorded; checklists: passed; uncommitted because no commit was requested

checkpoints.description: Task 'stellaris-ui-v1' completed successfully.
[1/2] Plan: replace iframe-only visual review with a real Playwright Edge driver, expose overlay states, and reveal the radar map

impact_assessment.why: The user asked for a real browser and the iframe method hid the true game: polling wiped event popups, the synthetic viewport produced wrapper screenshots, and the Stellaris deck-panel gradient covered the full-viewport radar
impact_assessment.benefits: True Edge screenshots at exact Windows viewports, reproducible target/event/combat states, visible starfield/nebula map, integrated Stellaris overlays, and a documented vision fallback for exhausted APIs
impact_assessment.risks: dependency: Playwright is dev-only and optional; concurrency: the browser driver starts its own server and stops it per run; contract: no runtime or layout-rule change; state: static UI, tooling, docs and metadata only
impact_assessment.mitigation: Real-browser captures at five Windows sizes, zero console/HTTP/tiny/hscroll findings, target/event/combat evidence, 496 tests, 4/4 gates and ADR-047
